title: fix(app-shell): designer inspector words with no catalogue row read new en-US and zh-CN rows (objectui#10748)
body:
Fixes #10748

Clause-②: no — designer inspector strings gain catalogue rows; no declared surface moves

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 under claim `5856979487` (mode:subagent, so the session is the seat's): `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`. Branch `claude/issue-10748-inspector-zh-rows`, base `bff63cc12e`, head `3af65cb9e4`.

## What changed

44 new `engine.*` rows in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, each in `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` and `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` (the objectui#10586 shape), and every site in the table below reads them in the designer locale. Each en row carries the English its literal did, so en-US renders the same words; that is measured below (the keys-only leg), not assumed. `pnpm check:i18n-drift` on the designer table: "0 en value(s) changed (44 key(s) added, 0 removed)".

How each site gets its locale — the channel its siblings already use:

- the host `locale` prop: `DashboardWidgetInspector`, `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `ObjectFieldInspector` (through a new `lookupOperatorOptions(locale)`), `FlowEdgeInspector`, `FlowNodeInspector`, `FlowNodeConfigField`;
- `useMetadataLocale()` in the shared pieces that take no locale: `VariableTextInput` (as `InspectorComboField` does), `FlowExprIssue` (as its sibling `FlowObjectListField` does) and `useFlowScope` (which builds the headings `VariableTextInput` renders, so the two always agree);
- an optional trailing `locale` parameter on the pure helpers, the way `flow-ref-check`'s `describeUnknownRefs` already takes one: `validateExpressionClient(role, raw, locale)`, `resolveFlowScope(draft, nodeId, locale)`, `triggerFieldRefs(trigger, fields, locale)`. An absent locale reads the en rows, so a caller that passes none renders exactly what it did.

Option tables keep their stored values: `WIDGET_TYPES` and `LOOKUP_OPERATORS` carry a `labelKey` (the `KeyedOption` shape of objectui#10586), resolved at render. `LOOKUP_OPERATORS` reuses the four `engine.inspector.condition.op.*` rows the condition builder already reads, with the symbol kept outside the translated word, and five new rows of the same family cover the rest. The loop-body crumb is translated in `previews/flow-region-label.ts` `displayRegionLabel`, beside `try` / `catch` (see Acceptance notes for why that file).

## Site table — re-derived on `origin/main` `bff63cc12e`

Census: an AST walk (TypeScript compiler API) over every string literal, template and JSX text in the 44 non-test sources of `metadata-admin/inspectors/`, filtered to English-looking words, then read in place; plus a pass over label-like props holding a single lower-case word. Every card row reproduced; nothing on the card was already translated on `origin/main`.

Left literal on purpose, unchanged (the objectui#10678 / objectui#10651 ruling): code samples and syntax hints, sample values, stored values and type tokens; `flow-node-config.ts` labels (the `FLOW_FIELD_ZH` channel); `ViewVariantInspector`'s `TYPE_LABELS` fallback; `DashboardDefaultInspector`'s `New widget` / `New TYPE` default title (author data written into the draft). Also left as code: the operator symbols, the ` · ` separator, reference tokens, type and object names, field labels inside a detail, and the code spans inside an expression message.

## Pins and ablation

`inspectors/inspectorStrings.i18n-10748.test.tsx`, built on the objectui#10696 harness: every case reads the rendered attribute or text; each zh expectation comes back from the catalogue through `zhRow`, which refuses the echoed key and the en row; each zh case has a lit control on the same mount (a word that was translated before this change), read before the site; each site has an en case. 46 cases = 21 zh + 20 en + 5 standalone lit controls.

- **Head** `3af65cb9e4`: `Tests 46 passed (46)`; with the objectui#10696 pin, `Test Files 2 passed (2)` · `Tests 68 passed (68)`.
- **Base leg** — all 13 touched source files, `i18n.ts` included, written from `bff63cc12e` (each blob hash-checked equal to the base blob), pin from head: `Tests 41 failed | 5 passed (46)`. The 5 are the standalone lit controls. The en cases fail too here only because their keys do not exist on base.
- **Keys-only leg** — `i18n.ts` from head, the other 12 files from base: `Tests 21 failed | 25 passed (46)`. The 21 are exactly the zh cases, each receiving its English literal: `Received: "KPI Metric"`, `"Unsupported selection kind: field"`, `"The selected widget was removed from the draft."`, `"Widget 1"` (twice), `'= equals', '≠ not equals', …`, `'= equals', '≥ at least', 'not in'`, `"Otherwise · default"`, `"nested node location"`, `[ 'For each', 'Body', 'Call' ]`, `"Must be a JSON object"`, `"Insert a reference"`, `"Search references…"`, `"No matching references."`, `[ 'Flow variables', …(3) ]`, `"variable · number"`, and the approval headings and the four expression messages in English. The 25 are the 20 en cases and the 5 lit controls: the rows alone change nothing on screen, and every en row equals the literal it replaced as rendered.
- Restore after each leg: `git checkout HEAD --` on the mutated paths, each path hash-equal to its HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` 0 lines.
- **Ablation** — the 44 new zh rows dropped (six blocks, each through `ablation-replace.mjs --delete --hold`, every anchor count 1 before and 0 after; afterwards each block's first key occurs once in the file, the en row), pin from head: `Tests 21 failed | 25 passed (46)`, exactly the 21 zh cases, each at the guard "a missing zh row echoes the key back"; direction: red, as predicted. Restore: blob `e34bbb4d06` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **en byte identity of the two message rows no render site reaches** (the template-role messages): a one-off harness called the base `validateExpressionClient` and the head one over 10 inputs, with no locale and with `en-US`, covering all six messages: every output equal. Deleted, never committed.
- The objectui#10696 pin found the crumb by `[aria-label="nested node location"]`; under zh that name is now its row, so its probe reads the row in the mount's language. Before that update 4 of its cases failed at the probe, not at an assertion.

- Open PR objectui#10792 (created 15:06Z, after the seat's 14:55Z read) touches three of these files: `FlowExprIssue.tsx`, `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`, `flow-scope.ts`. The edits here stay off its hunks, and `git merge-tree --write-tree` of its head `8e4e5982af` with this head: exit 0, tree `38564ee84b`. In `FlowExprIssue` that is why only the shape-error line reads the locale and the unknown-reference call does not (row 18). The union's tests were not run (NOT MEASURED).

## Acceptance notes

- Card premises, measured: (a) "The canvas header shows the same word" for `Body` does not hold: `extractRegions` gives a loop body no label, so the canvas draws no header for it; the crumb is its only reader, and `displayRegionLabel` translates `body` only when the label is the `Body` fallback, so the canvas still draws nothing. (b) The card's three `Widget N` sites are the widget header, the widget list and `selectWidget`'s selection label; the last sits behind `widget.id ||` after an early return on a missing id, so no mount reaches it — it reads the row and is not pinned. The add-widget default title is `New widget` / `New TYPE`, author data, left literal. (c) The expression messages have a third render site, `FlowNodeConfigField`; the two template-role messages have none (every caller passes a CEL role), so they read rows without a pin.
- Declared file-surface additions, both bounded in-place: `previews/flow-region-label.ts` — the loop-body crumb is a card site, and `displayRegionLabel` is the one place a region's fallback header is translated (its header says so); translating `Body` anywhere else would make that sentence false. Same defect class, a one-line branch in the shape pinned for `try` / `catch`, no open PR holds the file, same gate family. `.changeset/10696-inspector-literals-read-existing-keys.md` — its "`Body` and an authored branch name pass through as before" goes false with this change, so it gains a dated note (frontmatter md5 `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` before and after); the paragraph stays as the record of that change.
- `flow-scope.ts` details (row 16) and the `FlowNodeConfigField` render site (row 17) are inside the claimed `inspectors/` surface, found while re-deriving the table, and are the same class.
- Left English here, for the seat: `FlowExprIssue`'s unknown-reference note (row 18 — after objectui#10792 lands, its `flowScopeNote` can pass the `locale` this change already reads); the flow Problems panel's copy of the row-15 messages (`previews/flow-expr-problems.ts` calls `validateExpressionClient` with no locale although its `checkCel` holds one; the file is in objectui#10792); and the Add-widget picker's popover (`previews/AddWidgetPicker.tsx`, `previews/widget-types.ts`: `Search widgets…`, `No matches.`, the category and type labels), mounted by `DashboardDefaultInspector` and `DashboardPreview`, which has no rows and whose type labels also feed the `New TYPE` default title.
- The zh wording follows the catalogue and the packs where they already name the thing: the chart names of `packages/i18n` `widgetType` (柱状图, 条形图 …), the filter operator words of its `operators` (包含, 属于, 不属于), `engine.flowRef.*`'s 引用, and full-width punctuation as the neighbouring rows use it.
